instituto: National Institute of Science and Technology in Simulation and Monitoring for Individual Assistance in Extreme Weather Events
nosso-time-texto: Meet the INCT SiMAI team, the people who make science happen!
pilares-texto: Discover the three pillars of INCT SiMAI!
pilar1: Risk Simulation: Predicting and analyzing population movements during severe weather events, enabling coordinated and informed responses. Furthermore, generating simulated scenarios and prospective data that allow the population to better understand the risks associated with the places where they live, study, and work, strengthening individual and collective preparedness.
pilar2: Real-time monitoring: Using data from mobile devices to create fast and personalized alert systems.
pilar3: Humanitarian Assistance: To provide essential guidance, support, and information before, during, and after risky situations, ensuring the physical and psychological recovery of individuals.
